job_summary: Oversee daily food preparation and kitchen operations, including menu planning, food preparation, cooking, quality control, inventory operations, and monitoring safety and sanitation practices.

hard_gates.requirement: Experience as a Chef or Head Cook
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires 1 year of experience as Chefs and Head Cooks.

hard_gates.requirement: Experience as a Cook preparing a wide variety of meals
hard_gates.source_support: The source job description explicitly requires 2 years of experience as Cooks dealing with a wide variety of meals.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to plan menus and develop menu options
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires menu planning, and O*NET lists planning menu options and collaborating to develop recipes or menus as tasks for chefs and head cooks.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to monitor food quality, sanitation, and compliance with established standards
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires attention to detail and monitoring safety and sanitation practices, while O*NET lists monitoring for compliance and checking food quality and supplies.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to manage food supplies and inventory-related resources
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires inventory management, and O*NET identifies Production and Processing knowledge and Management of Material Resources as relevant to food-service operations.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to communicate and coordinate with kitchen staff and others
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job description requires communication abilities, while O*NET identifies Speaking, Coordination, and communication with supervisors, peers, and subordinates as relevant.

soft_criteria.criterion: Ability to organize and prioritize food preparation and kitchen activities
soft_criteria.why_relevant: The job requires directing food preparation and cooking, while O*NET lists organizing, planning, prioritizing, scheduling, and coordinating food production activities.

soft_profile.candidate_evidence: Demonstrates strong ability to plan menus and develop menu options.
Demonstrates moderate ability to monitor food quality, sanitation, and compliance with established standards.
Demonstrates limited ability to manage food supplies and inventory-related resources.
Demonstrates strong ability to communicate and coordinate with kitchen staff and others.
Demonstrates moderate ability to organize and prioritize food preparation and kitchen activities.
